title: Kaveri Microfinance: customer KYC records scraped from the loan app API
types: Attack on applications (e-governance, e-commerce and others)
Unauthorised access of IT systems or data
must: Indicators should include the scraper's address, 198.51.100.66.
Say which system was affected: the loan app API.
Say what you have done so far (blocked, fixed, revoked).
Say how many records were exposed.

inbox.subject: Logs requested
inbox.body: Please preserve and share the API access logs and WAF logs for 8 June 2027, and confirm the time synchronisation source of the affected servers.

inbox.subject: Update: the flaw is older than we thought
inbox.body: The developers found the missing ownership check was released on 21 May. We have searched back to then: no other client asked for other customers' IDs. The fix went live at 07:15 UTC and the token for customer 118842 is revoked. Please send CERT-In an update.

inbox.subject: A journalist is asking
inbox.body: A reporter at a business paper says she has a sample of Kaveri customer records and asks for comment by 14:00 IST. What do we say?
